name: DuoLun Technology Corporation Ltd.
summary: DuoLun Technology Corporation Ltd. develops motor vehicle driver intelligent training, testing, and application systems in China. It provides smart vehicle management, smart driver training, smart city, and smart vehicle inspection services. The company also offers commercial and industrial liquid-cooled energy storage cabinet, home energy storage systems, and mobile integrated storage and charging equipment; charging management platform and charging equipment; embodied and coffee robots. In addition, it provides integrated photovoltaic-storage-charging-inspection, microgrid system, and charging station management solutions.
